title: Letters on Brass
request: Make my badge by joining prefix and number with nothing between them. The brass engraver accepts text; it is very literal.
objective: Convert a number to text before concatenating it.
starter:
# Join prefix and number into one piece of text.
badge = ___
deliver(badge)
hints: The badge is prefix followed by number: 'Fern-' and 7 make 'Fern-7'.
+ joins two pieces of text, but number is a number. str(number) turns it into text first.
Write badge = prefix + str(number), then deliver(badge).
inputCode:
import random
prefix = random.choice(['Fern-', 'Moss-', 'Cloud-'])
number = random.randint(1, 99)
